summary: Teaching wavetable synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A table (ten built in, or your own WAV) read at a position that an LFO can sweep, with Bend on the left of centre and hard Sync on the right of the phase warp (at High quality), a sine sub, an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for evolving pads, sync leads, vocal and digital textures, or to learn how wavetable synthesis works.

parameters.name: Frame Pos
parameters.description: Selects and interpolates the active single-cycle waveform across the frames of the loaded table.
parameters.how: Selects and interpolates the active single-cycle waveform across the frames of the loaded table.
parameters.sound: Sweeps smoothly through changing timbral shapes, from dark fundamentals to complex harmonic structures.

parameters.name: Phase Warp
parameters.description: Bends the phase read within each cycle: left of centre pinches it (Bend), right of centre hard-syncs it (Sync).
parameters.how: Bends the phase read within each cycle: left of centre pinches it (Bend), right of centre hard-syncs it (Sync).
parameters.sound: Pinches the waveform for nasal hard-sync tones or hollow pulse-width effects regardless of the selected table.

parameters.name: Wavetable
parameters.description: Selects one of Dye Essence's tables (Basic, PWM, Harmonics, Formants, Sync sweep, FM sweep, Organ, Resonant, Digital, Grit) or User, a table you load.
parameters.how: Selects one of Dye Essence's tables (Basic, PWM, Harmonics, Formants, Sync sweep, FM sweep, Organ, Resonant, Digital, Grit) or User, a table you load.
parameters.sound: Changes the fundamental sonic palette and harmonic progression of the oscillator.

parameters.name: Motion Rate
parameters.description: Sets the speed of the internal LFO/envelope generator that automatically moves the frame position.
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the internal LFO/envelope generator that automatically moves the frame position.
parameters.sound: Controls whether the timbre evolves slowly like a cinematic pad or wobbles rapidly like a modulated bass.

parameters.name: Motion Depth
parameters.description: Sets the travel distance and direction of the automatic wavetable frame scanner.
parameters.how: Sets the travel distance and direction of the automatic wavetable frame scanner.
parameters.sound: At 0% the wavetable frame remains static; higher values animate the waveform across the table automatically.

parameters.name: Sub Anchor
parameters.description: Blends in a clean, unwarped fundamental sine wave at the root pitch.
parameters.how: Blends in a clean, unwarped fundamental sine wave at the root pitch.
parameters.sound: Keeps the low end solid and musical even when the main wavetable is heavily warped or bright.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.

imports.description: A WAV wavetable: frames of 2048 samples (or a clm chunk saying the frame size), or one short single cycle. It becomes the machine's "User" table (item 0), and Wavetable is set to User.
